_note: Bard (2024), a full caster. Reconstructed from shipped generated data to restore the build source of truth; base + subclasses retain their original sources.

classes.name: Bard
startingEquipment: Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Musical Instrument, Entertainer's Pack, 19 GP
classes.flavor: A spellcasting performer whose magic uplifts allies and unravels foes — the party's face, utility caster, and jack of all trades.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action you give another creature within 60 feet a Bardic Inspiration die (starting at d6, growing to d12). Within 10 minutes it can add the die to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You have a number of uses equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1), regained on a Long Rest (and, from level 5, a Short Rest).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Bard spells using Charisma, preparing a growing list (shown on the table) plus cantrips. Save DC is 8 + Charisma modifier + proficiency bonus; attack bonus is Charisma modifier + proficiency bonus. You can use a Musical Instrument as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skill proficiencies to gain Expertise (double proficiency). Choose two more at level 9.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that doesn't already include it.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: You regain all uses of Bardic Inspiration on a Short or Long Rest, and you can expend a spell slot (no action) to regain one use.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: As a Magic action you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn: you and allies within 30 feet have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened and Charmed conditions.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Whenever you prepare Bard spells, you can also choose from the Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists — the divine, primal, and arcane traditions are open to you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat. Repeats at 8th, 12th, and 16th level.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Spell Recall is a fitting choice.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.description: You always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared, and when you cast either you can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.flavor: A collector of secrets and skills who can deflate a foe's success with a well-placed word.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: When a creature within 60 feet you can see makes a damage roll or succeeds on an attack roll or ability check, you can use a Reaction to expend a Bardic Inspiration die and subtract it from the roll, potentially turning a hit into a miss.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
features.description: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists; they count as Bard spells and are always prepared.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die and add it to the roll, possibly turning failure into success.

subclasses.name: College of Dance
subclasses.flavor: A bard whose art is motion — a whirling dancer who fights unarmed and flows untouched through the fray.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.description: While unarmored and not using a Shield, your AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier, and you gain an Unarmed Strike that uses a Bardic Inspiration die for damage plus Agile Strikes (a free Unarmed Strike when you spend Bardic Inspiration).

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: When an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can use a Reaction to move and let an ally within 60 feet move, expending a Bardic Inspiration die that they add to their next roll.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: When you make a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure, and you can extend this protection to allies within 5 feet.

subclasses.name: College of Glamour
subclasses.flavor: A bard touched by the Feywild whose beauty commands and beguiles, rallying allies and awing enemies into submission.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.description: You always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared. When you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell of level 1+, you can force a creature you can see to make a Wisdom save or be Charmed or Frightened until the end of your next turn. Also gain Mantle of Inspiration: spend Bardic Inspiration to grant nearby allies Temporary HP and a free Reaction move.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action you can cast Command without a slot and radiate majesty for 1 minute, casting Command each round as a Bonus Action; creatures have Disadvantage to resist. Once per Long Rest without a slot.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action you assume an awe-inspiring presence for 1 minute; the first time a creature attacks you each turn it must make a Charisma save or lose the attack, and it has Disadvantage on saves against your spells.

subclasses.name: College of Valor
subclasses.flavor: A skald and warrior-poet who fights on the front line and lends martial vigor to comrades.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: A creature holding one of your Bardic Inspiration dice can add it to a weapon's damage roll, or use it as a Reaction to boost AC against one attack. You also gain proficiency with Martial weapons, Medium armor, and Shields.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action. You can replace one of these attacks with a cantrip that has a casting time of an action.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: When you take the Magic action to cast a Bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
